briefdescription.para: Return true if a key part using the second collation can be merged into a key def using the first collation for the same field.

detaileddescription.para: Using the two collations together for the same field in the same key def only makes sense if the second collation may impose a strict order on keys equal in terms of the first collation.

Can return an existing collation object, if a one with the same fingerprint was created before.
